sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Concéntrico returned to Logroño for its 12th edition in June and transformed the city into a working site for architecture. Since its founding in 2015, the festival has built an identity on resisting a distant, controlled exhibition of design by constructing full-scale installations in the city's streets, plazas, and vacant lots, engaging residents and visitors as part of daily life . This year's program brought together more than twenty interventions by a rchitects, designers, and researchers working across a wide range of geographies and methods, each contributing to a citywide experiment in reimagining public space.
